scenario: Client carrying significant credit card debt across multiple providers, considering a balance transfer.
transcript: I'm 35, single, take-home around £2,900 a month. I've got about £11,000 across four credit cards, average rate around 22%. I'm paying minimums but it's not going anywhere. I've seen those 0% balance transfer cards advertised but I'm worried it's some kind of trap. I do have £1,200 in savings. No mortgage, I rent.
expected_llm_claims: Balance-transfer credit cards typically offer 0% on transferred balances for a fixed promotional window.
You should open a Barclaycard Platinum balance-transfer card and move all four balances onto it.
Many people consolidate higher-interest card debt with a 0% balance-transfer card.
Doing this will definitely improve your credit score.
